title: Atzlk MC: Server
description: 1.21.1 NeoForge Tornado Modded SMP w/ Weather Storms & Tornadoes (Weather2) + Expanded Weather2 Dynamics
body:
# mc.atzlk.com - Weather Storms & Tornadoes (Weather2) SMP
mc.atzlk.com is a Weather Storms & Tornadoes (Weather2) + Expanded Weather2 Dynamics Survival SMP! You can join and create towns with other people. From tornadoes, cyclones, squalls and wildfires this server contains many weather challenges with hundreds of active members in the [discord](https://discord.gg/atzlk), creating towns, countries & civilisations.

In this server: Tornadoes, Storms, Cyclones, Firenadoes & more.

- Weather Storms & Tornadoes (Weather2) + Expanded Weather2 Dynamics is required on NeoForge 1.21.1 (v21.1.230) to play on the server.
- Simple Voice Chat Mod also supported
